0022600035.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-10, on a seven-game losing streak and 0-5 on the road) visit the Orlando Magic (3-7, on a one-game winning streak) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group A matchup, the Bucks' 13th game of the season. Milwaukee is without Myles Turner, who is out to rest, while Orlando is missing seven players: Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jamal Cain (shoulder bruise), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Tristan da Silva (calf strain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Bucks lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 130-91 defeat in Milwaukee on March 8, 2026.
